'**Instant** - {r}{r}{r}, destroy this: Put target attack action card from your graveyard on top of your deck.' Generic Equipment - Head.

ACTIVATION SHAPE: card-level activation_cost 3 (read by the loader, loader.py:153, and the cost pipeline); ability_type INSTANT (instant-speed activated ability -> ON_ACTIVATE, trigger_types.py:115). _add_hero_dsl_activations offers INSTANT abilities from equipment zones including head (play.py:238-339) and checks the ability's DSL costs - DESTROY_SELF cost exists (cost_types.py:43-51), pays via canonical destroy so the helm leaves the head zone as a cost BEFORE resolution.

THE PUT CLAUSE is MOVE_MATCHING, whose docstring names exactly this wording ('put target <card matching X> from <zone> on top of your deck', effect_types.py:3593-3612): embedded object target over zone GRAVEYARD (a supported _OBJECT_TARGET_ZONES entry, resolved by _object_zone_cards to player.graveyard.cards), controller SELF, amount 1 chosen by the player at resolution, filter CARD_IS_ATTACK (= Card.is_attack, 'Attack' in subtypes, card.py:351-353 - the corpus's established test for attack action cards; destroyed weapons carry no Attack subtype so they cannot be mis-picked). position 'top' reaches put_object with position='top'.

WHY NOT the triage's exact primitives: SEARCH_GRAVEYARD defaults shuffle=True for deck destinations and passes no position, so it shuffles instead of putting on top; PUT_REF_TOP reads a ref that no preceding effect sets (SEARCH_GRAVEYARD stores none). CARD_TYPE_IN, also named by the triage, does not exist in condition_types.py despite being documented in DSL_REFERENCE.md.

LEGALITY GATE: CR 1.8.5 makes a targeted ability illegal to play with no legal target. The engine's offer-time target_filter check evaluates conditions against the SOURCE card only (play.py:314-317), so an ability-level target declaration would wrongly demand the HELM be an attack. Instead the gate is ability-level CARD_IN_ZONE graveyard/subtype Attack/count>=1 (condition_types.py:844+, reads zone/subtypes/count_gte), checked both when offering (play.py:307) and at resolution. The player still chooses WHICH attack action card at resolution via MOVE_MATCHING's ask.

No unresolved gaps.
